title: Entity Knockback Roar Behavior
description: Allows the mob to perform a damaging knockback that affects all nearby entities.

on_roar_end.title: Roar End Event
on_roar_end.description: Event that is triggered when the roar ends. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

attack_time.title: Attack Time
attack_time.description: The delay after which the knockback occurs (in seconds).

cooldown_time.title: Cooldown Time
cooldown_time.description: Time (in seconds) the mob has to wait before using the goal again.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

damage_filters.title: Damage Filters
damage_filters.description: The list of conditions another entity must meet to be a valid target to apply damage to.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The max duration of the roar (in seconds).

knockback_damage.title: Knockback Damage
knockback_damage.description: The damage dealt by the knockback roar.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

knockback_filters.title: Knockback Filters
knockback_filters.description: The list of conditions another entity must meet to be a valid target to apply knockback to.

knockback_height_cap.title: Knockback Height Cap
knockback_height_cap.description: The maximum height for vertical knockback.

knockback_horizontal_strength.title: Knockback Horizontal Strength
knockback_horizontal_strength.description: The strength of the horizontal knockback.

knockback_range.title: Knockback Range
knockback_range.description: The radius (in blocks) of the knockback effect.

knockback_vertical_strength.title: Knockback Vertical Strength
knockback_vertical_strength.description: The strength of the vertical knockback.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
